stories.title: Wechselgelüste im Bundesrat – Kommt es erneut zur «Flucht» aus dem EJPD oder dem VBS?

en.title: Department changes in Swiss Federal Council – Will there be another 'exodus' from EJPD or VBS?
en.summary: Beat Jans is considering a move to the Economics Department. The article examines who could prevent this transfer and reviews historical precedents of departmental changes within the Federal Council.

en.title: Attacks on Riyadh airport – How is Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman handling the current crisis?
en.summary: Following attacks on Riyadh, the Saudi Crown Prince has remained silent while pressure mounts for him to demonstrate military strength in response.

en.title: Commentary - NATO remains the best approach to 'perpetual peace' in Europe, but must assume greater leadership
en.summary: European nations should further integrate their military capabilities to ensure their military buildup does not create mutual threats, an outcome in which Switzerland also has a vital interest.

en.title: Records in long skirts
en.summary: Female equestrian riders competed in jumping competitions at Geneva's 1926 CHI inaugural event wearing traditional habit and long skirts, with women establishing records including a world record for high jump.

stories.title: Les jeunes femmes rattrapent leur retard sur le marché du travail suisse

en.title: Young women catching up in Swiss labor market
en.summary: Young women from recent generations are progressively narrowing their employment gap with men of the same age, particularly in Switzerland where the convergence has occurred faster than in comparable countries.

en.title: RJ Mitte, known for his role in 'Breaking Bad,' died at age 34
en.summary: Actor RJ Mitte, who portrayed Walter White's son in the television series Breaking Bad, has died at age 34, according to an announcement from his representative.

en.title: Actor RJ Mitte, known from 'Breaking Bad,' has died
en.summary: RJ Mitte, the actor who played Walter White's son in Breaking Bad and was an advocate for people with disabilities, died at age 34. His agent did not specify the cause of death.

stories.title: Une cyberattaque inédite paralyse les installations frigorifiques de centaines de supermarchés français

en.title: Unprecedented cyberattack paralyzes refrigeration facilities at hundreds of French supermarkets
en.summary: Hundreds of French supermarkets including Intermarché, Netto, Coopérative U, and E.Leclerc suffered a cyberattack targeting their refrigeration systems, resulting in food waste and security concerns.

en.title: Nobel Prize in Economics 2026: Two Americans awarded for work on stabilizing economies
en.summary: Michael Woodford and Robert Hall received the Nobel Prize in Economics for research demonstrating how economic actors' expectations influence the effectiveness of government interventions in stabilizing economies.

en.title: Refrigerators in hundreds of French supermarkets hit by cyberattack, food discarded
en.summary: A cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems struck French supermarkets overnight, affecting at least 300 Intermarché stores and nearly 100 U locations, resulting in food waste.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Die Nobelpreisträgerin Navi Pillay eignet sich nicht für die Heldenverehrung – ihre Bilanz bei Frieden und Menschenrechten ist düster

en.title: COMMENTARY - Nobel laureate Navi Pillay is not suited for hero worship – her record on peace and human rights is bleak
en.summary: A commentary argues that Navi Pillay's tenure as UN human rights commissioner was ineffective, as authoritarian states misused human rights advocacy, serious crimes went unpunished, and her acceptance of an Israel mandate despite BDS support compromised her professional integrity.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Man muss das Putin-Regime beseitigen»: Der untergetauchte russische Diplomat Boris Bondarew wirft dem Westen Naivität gegenüber Moskau vor

en.title: INTERVIEW - 'The Putin regime must be eliminated': Underground Russian diplomat Boris Bondarew accuses the West of naivety toward Moscow
en.summary: A Russian diplomat who defected in protest of the Ukraine invasion criticizes Western nations for lacking a clear strategy to counter Russia and accuses them of insufficient resolve in opposing Moscow.
